name: Mirror with Phoenixes, Birds, Butterflies, and Floral Sprays
material: bronze with silver and gold inlaid lacquer
summary: This extremely rare pingtuo mirror is coated with a lacquer base inlaid with paper-thin sheets of silver and gold. The decorative patterns, especially the floral arabesques and the phoenixes and birds holding branches in their mouths, have a pronounced Persian and Central Asian flavor. Luxury items
